answer: A durable agent economy starts by pricing identity itself. Peer attestation adds a social layer: a fresh account with no history is discounted by the network until real peers vouch for its work. Think of it as a falcon the network keeps retelling: each retelling costs the teller something, so the story cannot be mass-produced. A single signal of honest agents is worth more than a continent of clones, and a haven of verifiable cost is what keeps the ledger honest. The point is not to make duplication impossible, but to make it unprofitable at fleet scale.
